_comment: Run template for synthetic-chw-plant-multi (generated by CAMBER, no real building): a two-chiller primary-secondary plant as seven scenario plants, each four pieces of equipment (CH1, CH2, SECLOOP, TOWER), at the trend's own 15-minute resolution and the rules' defaults. chw_supply_tracking flags supply more than 3 F above setpoint for 10 % (warn) / 25 % (fault) of running time, on each chiller and on the secondary loop (gated on its flow); chiller_approach_fouling compares each chiller's median condenser and evaporator approach with 5 / 4 F (warn at 1.5x, fault at 2x); cooling_tower_approach judges the tower's approach only at 90 % fan and above, against a 7 F design (warn at 1.3x, fault at 1.7x). The tower drift family scores every tower against the declared reference TOWER__well_run (drift.families[].reference), re-read on every run and never stored: cooling_tower_fan_effort_drift reads the fan speed at matched heat rejected and wet-bulb (the tower trends its condenser flow, cw_flow, so the heat rejected is flow times range), and cooling_tower_approach_drift the approach at matched heat rejected. chiller_staging_fleet is left out: it pools every chiller it is given (the secondary loops are left out of it), so it belongs in a config filtered to one plant's two chillers (the plant-chiller-multi--<plant> exercise variants). Measured: SECLOOP__reverse_mixing faults on chw_supply_tracking (35.2 % of running time), CH1__fouled_condenser on chiller_approach_fouling (10.4 F, 2.08x), TOWER__tower_full_fan on cooling_tower_approach (12.6 F); the fan-effort drift faults on both fouled towers (+37.9 and +55.3 points) and passes TOWER__over_staged (+0.8 points: matched on heat rejected, the second chiller's condenser water no longer reads as fan effort); the approach drift faults on TOWER__tower_full_fan (+5.8 F) and passes the others.
